ad_info.reference_style: New Year seasonal lifestyle supplement ad with a woman from behind, bottle, mug with handwritten phrase and a bottom row of trust items with a button

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: ultra-photorealistic woman from behind in ribbed pink short shorts in a bright bedroom, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Aspirational, calm and self-loving; soft morning daylight.
global_identity.graphic_language: Stacked bold headline, a fuchsia pill line, hot fuchsia circles with white line icons, a ceramic mug with handwritten text, handwritten script with heart, a white bottom strip with outlined circular icons and a rounded fuchsia button with a gift icon, real aguaje fruits.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (heavy, uppercase) for the headline and trust items, Poppins Regular for icon texts, casual handwritten script for the accents.

creative_objective: Speak to identity and New Year's resolutions: investing in yourself, with discipline and self-love, to get natural curves.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The stacked headline top-left ('INVIERTE EN TI'). 2) The woman from behind on the right. 3) The bottle in the center. 4) Icons, mug, script and the bottom row.
art_direction.composition_style: Top-left: kicker line, giant two-line headline and a two-line subtitle (second line inside a pill). Left, under the headline: three icon rows. Right half: the woman from behind from waist to thighs. Center: the bottle large with capsules in front. Lower-left: a mug with handwritten text on a pink knit blanket, aguaje fruits in front. Lower-right: a handwritten script with heart. Bottom: a white strip with three trust items and a fuchsia button on the right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline block 3-30% height, left 60%. Icon rows 32-58% height, left 30%. Woman 48-100% width, 0-80% height. Bottle 33-60% width, 38-85% height. Mug 0-30% width, 58-80% height; fruits 5-30% width, 75-88%. Script 65-90% width, 68-80% height. Bottom strip 88-100% height: three trust items on the left 70%, button on the right 28%.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft morning daylight from a window, shallow depth of field on the room, glossy highlight on the bottle, soft shadows on the blanket.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Bright bedroom with a pink knit blanket. Top-left: a small bold uppercase kicker, then a giant bold two-line headline, then a two-line uppercase subtitle with the second line inside a fuchsia pill. Below on the left: three icon rows (fuchsia circle with white line icon plus two-line text). Right half: a woman from behind from waist to upper thighs in ribbed pink short shorts and a white top. Center: the bottle large with fuchsia capsules in front. Lower-left: a white ceramic mug with handwritten text and a heart on the blanket, aguaje fruits (one halved) with leaves in front. Lower-right: a handwritten script phrase with a heart. Bottom: a white strip with three trust items (outlined circular icon plus two-line uppercase text) and a rounded fuchsia button with a gift icon and two-line uppercase text.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium New Year supplement lifestyle ad in a bright bedroom with soft morning daylight, pale blush pink tones and a soft pink knit blanket across the lower part. TOP-LEFT: a small bold uppercase black kicker line, below it a giant two-line bold uppercase headline in hot fuchsia (#E6177F), below it a two-line bold uppercase subtitle: first line in deep magenta (#B0105E), second line in white inside a hot fuchsia rounded pill. LEFT, under the headline: three rows, each a hot fuchsia circle with a thin white line icon (a rounded glutes silhouette, legs, a leaf) and short two-line dark gray text to its right. RIGHT HALF, camera at hip height: an ultra-photorealistic Latina woman in her mid 20s seen from behind from the waist to upper thighs, long dark hair, wearing a fitted white crop top and very short fitted ribbed pink (#FF8CC0) shorts; her glutes are full, round and lifted and her thighs toned, with natural, believable volume. Maximum realism: real skin texture with visible pores, natural creases, subtle skin tone variation, realistic ribbed fabric texture, real photo quality; no plastic or airbrushed skin; tasteful, non-explicit fitness styling. CENTER, large, standing on the blanket: the product. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product, and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern and a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth; black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS'. A small pile of glossy fuchsia capsules in front of it. LOWER-LEFT: a white ceramic mug on the knit blanket with deep magenta handwritten text in three lines and a small heart below; in front of it real aguaje fruits with shiny scaly reddish-brown skin, one cut in half showing orange flesh (#D9572B), and green leaves. LOWER-RIGHT, over the photo: a hot fuchsia handwritten script phrase in two lines with a small heart. BOTTOM: a white strip across the full width with three trust items on the left separated by space, each a black outlined circle with a line icon (a leaf, a bottle, a capsule) and two-line bold uppercase black text, and on the right a rounded hot fuchsia button with a white gift icon and two-line white bold uppercase text. Include only these elements and texts.
